Around [[3708 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a '''Great Hunt''' was held by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], and a young [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Hedarr Soongh]] competed. Soongh emerged victorious in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], becoming the youngest competitor to ever win the title of [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]].<ref name="TOR:HR" />
